body.name: \(\widehat{\mathcal S}_{n,k}\)
body.def: \(\widehat{\mathcal S}_{n,k}=\{j:\widehat r_{n,j}\le k\}\), where \(\widehat r_{n,j}=1+\sum_{j^{\prime}\ne j}\mathbf 1\{(\widehat s_n(Z_{j^{\prime}}),V_{j^{\prime}},j^{\prime})<_{\mathrm{lex}}(\widehat s_n(Z_j),V_j,j)\}\) and \(Z_j=(X_{n_{\mathcal R}+j},Y_{n_{\mathcal R}+j},V_{n_{\mathcal R}+j})\).
